title: Building Commission NSW
summary: This page provides information about the Building Commission NSW, which helps citizens understand building regulations and lodge complaints.

internal_links.text: Lodge a home building complaint with the Building Commission NSW

faqs.q: Where can I find information about the Building Commission NSW?
faqs.a: You can find more information about the Building Commission NSW at https://www.nsw.gov.au/building-commission.

faqs.q: How do I lodge a home building complaint?
faqs.a: You can lodge a home building complaint with the Building Commission NSW via this link: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/lodge-a-home-building-complaint-with-the-building-commission-nsw.
